name: Monk (2024)
description: Monks use rigorous combat training and mental discipline to align themselves with the multiverse and focus their internal reservoirs of power (Focus Points).

weapons: Martial weapons that have the Light property
tools: Choose one type of Artisan_s Tools or Musical Instrument

starting_equipment_options: (A) Spear, 5 Daggers, Artisan’s Tools or Musical Instrument chosen for proficiency, Explorer’s Pack, and 11 GP
focus_points_progression_note: Gains Focus Points equal to Monk level, as shown in Monk Features table.

1.name: Martial Arts
1.description: Mastery of combat styles using Unarmed Strike and Monk weapons (Simple Melee, Martial Melee with Light property). Benefits while unarmed/only Monk weapons & no armor/shield: Bonus Unarmed Strike (Bonus Action); Martial Arts Die (use for Unarmed/Monk weapon damage); Dexterous Attacks (Dex for attack/damage with Unarmed/Monk weapons, and for Grapple/Shove DC).

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While not wearing armor or wielding a Shield, AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

2.name: Monk_s Focus
2.description: Harness energy represented by Focus Points (equal to Monk level, regain on Short/Long Rest). Spend points for features: Flurry of Blows (1 pt, 2 Unarmed Strikes as Bonus Action), Patient Defense (Disengage as Bonus Action; OR 1pt, Disengage AND Dodge as Bonus Action), Step of the Wind (Dash as Bonus Action; OR 1pt, Disengage AND Dash as Bonus Action, jump distance doubled). Save DC = 8 + Wis mod + Prof Bonus.

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.description: Speed increases while not wearing armor/shield (see progression).

2.name: Uncanny Metabolism
2.description: When rolling Initiative, can regain all expended Focus Points. Roll Martial Arts die, regain HP = Monk level + roll. Once per Long Rest.

3.name: Deflect Attacks
3.description: Reaction to reduce Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing damage from an attack by 1d10 + Dex mod + Monk level. If damage reduced to 0, can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect force (make attack vs creature within 5ft (melee) or 60ft (ranged); target makes Dex save or takes damage = 2x Martial Arts die + Dex mod, same type as original attack).

3.name: Monk Subclass
3.description: Gain a Monk subclass. (Warrior of the Open Hand detailed in Basic Rules).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

4.name: Slow Fall
4.description: Reaction when falling to reduce fall damage by 5x Monk level.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice when taking Attack action.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: Once per turn when hitting with Monk weapon/Unarmed Strike, can expend 1 Focus Point. Target makes Con save. Fail: Stunned until start of your next turn. Success: Speed halved, next attack roll vs target has Advantage.

6.name: Empowered Strikes
6.description: Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage or its normal damage type.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: Dex save for half damage -> take no damage on success, half on fail (if not Incapacitated).

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

9.name: Acrobatic Movement
9.description: While no armor/shield, can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on turn without falling.

10.name: Heightened Focus
10.description: Flurry of Blows (1 Focus Point for 3 Unarmed Strikes). Patient Defense (1 Focus Point also grants Temp HP = 2x Martial Arts die). Step of the Wind (1 Focus Point also allows moving a willing creature within 5ft with you).

10.name: Self-Restoration
10.description: End Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned condition on self at end of each turn. Forgoing food/drink doesn’t cause Exhaustion.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

13.name: Deflect Energy
13.description: Deflect Attacks feature now works against attacks dealing any damage type.

14.name: Disciplined Survivor
14.description: Gain proficiency in all saving throws. If fail a save, can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll (must use new roll).

15.name: Perfect Focus
15.description: When rolling Initiative (and not using Uncanny Metabolism), regain Focus Points up to 4 if you have 3 or fewer.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

18.name: Superior Defense
18.description: At start of turn, can expend 3 Focus Points for 1 min Resistance to all damage except Force (or until Incapacitated).

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Irresistible Offense recommended).

20.name: Body and Mind
20.description: Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4 (max 25).

source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Monk Class
